research_goal: Overcome adaptive RTK/SHP2 feedback and secondary Switch-II mutations under KRAS G12D inhibition in PDAC

hypotheses.title: Dual MRTX1133 + SHP2 (RMC-4630) pulsatile blockade prevents adaptive RTK-driven WT RAS reactivation
hypotheses.rationale: RTK-SHP2-SOS1 nucleotide exchange reactivates WT HRAS/NRAS within 48h of G12D suppression; intermittent SHP2 co-inhibition collapses pERK rebound while sparing GI mucosa.

hypotheses.title: C2-fluorinated pyrrolizidine C-O-C conformational lock mitigates Tyr96Asp/His95Gln Switch-II groove resistance
hypotheses.rationale: Pre-organizing the C2 sidechain reduces entropic penalty when His95 hydrogen bonding is lost in acquired resistance clones.

hypotheses.title: Phenolic pivaloyloxymethyl (POM) prodrug of MRTX1133 masks naphthol HBD to achieve >35% oral bioavailability
hypotheses.rationale: Masking the 3-hydroxynaphthyl donor lowers TPSA from 93.5 to 79.2 A^2 and increases Caco-2 Papp >3-fold.

hypotheses.title: ULK1 autophagy co-inhibition synergizes with G12D blockade in nutrient-deprived PDAC organoids
hypotheses.rationale: PDAC cells upregulate macropinocytosis and autophagy upon MAPK pathway suppression.
